scope: Lightweight educational curation using retained official metadata and familiar task concepts

records.rationale: Practical map-based name allocation teaches lookup,duplicate handling and maintaining a small counter per key.
A clean greedy bracket-matching scan teaches maintaining unmatched openings and recognizing what can be safely paired.
Useful introductory extreme-value counting with a separate all-equal case;reinforces careful combinatorial counting.
A direct sort-once,answer-many-count-queries exercise that makes upper-bound semantics concrete.
A compact recurrence-periodicity exercise with modular arithmetic and negative residues;useful number-pattern practice.
Practices reducing an unbounded-looking integer rectangle optimization to a bounded search with rounding.
A friendly minimax coverage exercise combining endpoint gaps and interior gaps with careful numeric output.
An accessible ordered greedy problem that develops local feasibility and the value of preserving room for later choices.
Good non-overlap and search-order practice;small-looking substring problems can expose incorrect first-match assumptions.
Connects a divisibility property to bounded subsequence enumeration;useful for recognizing a small exhaustive search.
Canonical subset-plus-last-item DP with pairwise bonuses;strong preparation for Hamiltonian-style state transitions.
A useful digit-DP exercise combining position rules,remainder state and upper-bound handling.
Develops strict two-dimensional dominance ordering,DP reconstruction and filtering around a required starting object.
Combines range gcd with occurrence counts;shows how arithmetic structure determines what a range query must store.
A concrete transport-feasibility flow model with reconstruction;useful after understanding capacities and conservation.
Useful approximate dictionary matching practice;requires care about length,one-change semantics and hash-collision handling.
A memorable border problem connecting prefix/suffix structure with an internal occurrence;good prefix-function practice.
Extends border detection to occurrence aggregation;teaches propagating prefix-function information rather than checking each border independently.
Practical repeated overlap matching with a linear string primitive;good exercise in avoiding repeated full-string comparisons.
Teaches transforming numeric pattern matching through adjacent differences before applying a standard string matcher.
Useful distinct-substring counting with a constrained window;best after basic substring enumeration and hashing caveats.
Develops contribution counting over expression placements;good advanced practice in separating digit positions from combinatorial choices.
A clear monotone resource-cost predicate,ideal for learning binary search on an answer.
Combines answer-dependent item costs with choosing the cheapest feasible set;good practice separating a decision check from optimization.
A concise resource-deficit feasibility check with a large answer range;reinforces overflow-safe monotone search.
Turns repeated environmental drift into an arithmetic reachability predicate;useful beyond straightforward array binary search.
An engaging interactive search using indirect second-maximum information;useful after ordinary binary search and query protocols.
Classic pair-sum range counting that exposes off-by-one boundaries and the difference between pairs and individual elements.
A short per-bit counting and modular-exponentiation exercise;useful once bitwise constraints are familiar.
Combines repeated-array cycle arithmetic with monotone prefix maxima;excellent practice handling impossible and multi-cycle queries.
Practices testing equal-sum partitions and deriving a useful search space from the total sum.
Connects prime multiplicities to a constructive factor sequence;good reinforcement after basic factorization.
A useful decimal rounding/carry greedy that builds intuition for digit-sum constraints.
Teaches counting edge contributions across all tree pairs and matching them to sorted factors.
Shows when a tiny bitmask answer space permits direct feasibility enumeration instead of complex per-choice optimization.
A strong tree-consistency exercise combining subtree counts,parity and local feasibility checks.
Good category decomposition:combine shared choices with paired one-sided choices using sorted prefix costs.
Useful discrete-versus-continuous optimization practice with exact comparisons around an analytic candidate.
Connects triangle inequalities to efficient range/contribution counting instead of enumerating all triples.
Develops prime-exponent reasoning over gcd/lcm expressions;good practice avoiding direct pair enumeration.
An accessible rerooting DP with positive/negative vertex contributions and a clear exclude-one-child transition.
A compact day-and-time-modulo DP;good practice turning local schedule choices into a finite state space.
Reinforces exact transformation/parity handling and comparing constructed strings;useful intermediate implementation practice.
A useful sequence DP where only parity and remaining resource counts matter,rather than the exact missing values.
A clean shared-letter connectivity model that introduces DSU through strings rather than explicit graph input.
A clear two-mode DP with an entry fee;useful preparation for stateful shortest-path and mode-switch problems.
Teaches how structural restrictions can collapse a graph-coloring optimization to a small family of path patterns.
A practical mutable-string range query with a compact merge operation;excellent segment-tree introduction.
Good row-state traversal practice with locally determined transitions;useful for replacing unnecessary graph machinery.
Connects factorization with factorial prime valuations and modular powers;a reusable number-theory combination.
Develops order-statistic reconstruction using prefix sums and selecting an available position by cumulative weight.
A classic all-roots tree objective showing how one root answer changes when crossing an edge.
Practices merging forced monotonic constraints and constructing a witness that exposes incompatible conditions.
Useful shortest-deletion/state-dedup practice for generating distinct subsequences;the easy version supports a direct search model.
A concise BFS-layer parity selection exercise;careful attention to the requested coverage property matters.
An approachable group-connectivity problem that teaches unioning a whole group through one representative.
A strong interval-DP example where equal symbols can merge operations;teaches why greedy deletion can fail.
Develops interval expansion and compression of repeated colors;good practice reducing a state space before DP.
